name: Counterspell

header.Casting Time: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

casting.casting_time: Reaction, which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components

authored_intent: Reaction to seen creature casting V/S/M spell within 60 feet; target CON save; failed save ends spell without effect; expended spell slot refunded, other costs retained; exact interrupted occurrence.

rules.text: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted.
If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn’t expended.
